purpose: Decide whether Operation INITIAL still occurs in Branch B, and if so with what risk posture, rather than inheriting the historical sortie automatically.

historical_anchors.event: Eastern Fleet remains in harbour training at Trincomalee.
Commander-in-Chief Eastern Fleet holds a flag/commanding-officer conference on future operations at Trincomalee.
Queen Elizabeth with Nizam, Quickmatch and Quality sails to Colombo to store to full capacity; Valiant/Ceylon carry out harbour gunnery practice.

Renown, Valiant, Ceylon, Emerald, Illustrious and eight destroyers sail for INITIAL; Illustrious lands 847 Sqn 9 Barracudas and embarks 1830 Sqn, giving 12 Barracudas and 27 Corsairs; fleet forms at 1630 and heads north under W/T silence.

branch_decision_gate.physical_capability: PASS. The ships used are available in the Branch and SLEUTH caused no combat damage. Queen Elizabeth can be omitted while replenishing at Colombo without collapsing the exercise force.
branch_decision_gate.command_release: PASS. The 5-Mar conference gives a plausible current command decision point rather than a historical-date autopilot.
branch_decision_gate.operational_slack: PASS_BUT_ESCORT_CONSTRAINED. Eight destroyers can be assembled only by cycling the Queen Elizabeth screen back early on 8 Mar; this is enough for a short fleet sweep but not evidence of abundant escort reserve.
branch_decision_gate.motive_and_payoff: PASS_STRONGER_THAN_HISTORICAL_CENTER. Training and show-of-force remain useful, and Branch loss of Chittagong increases the value of demonstrating that the Bay of Bengal is not conceded to Japan. The operation is not intended to seek a fleet battle.
branch_decision_gate.information_quality: NOT_TARGET_DEPENDENT. No Japanese fleet target is required because INITIAL is a training/demonstration sweep.
branch_decision_gate.opportunity_cost: ACCEPTABLE_ONLY_WITH_RISK_LIMITS. Illustrious is the locally irreplaceable modern flight deck, so the force should not deliberately penetrate the Andaman/Chittagong land-air envelope merely to create contact.

Illustrious_air_group_08Mar.interpretation: Fighter-heavy carrier posture is historically exact and is especially rational in Branch B because Japanese land-air threat from the Andaman/Bengal system is more credible. It is not evidence that Britain intends an offensive carrier strike on Port Blair or Chittagong.

branch_route_posture.center: Keep the historical west/central Bay sweep concept toward the Vizagapatam axis; do not deliberately swing east toward the Andamans without a new target/mission decision.
branch_route_posture.reason: Shows force to India/Bengal and provides sea room for fleet training while limiting exposure of Illustrious to Japanese land-based aviation.
abort_or_turn_south_triggers: confirmed maintained Japanese air shadow with strike follow-up
credible submarine datum inside fleet manoeuvre box that cannot be cleared
fresh evidence of a prepared Japanese surface ambush east of the sweep axis

08Mar_progress.state: Fleet assembling/operating off Ceylon; no enemy contact.
Fleet forms as a unit, W/T silence enforced, course northward.
INITIAL underway north in west-central Bay corridor; no Japanese weapon-quality contact adjudicated.
